assessment: This paper investigates the impact of seasonal variation (e.g. nutrition, environment, and infection) in rural subsistence farmer communities in the Gambia on DNA methylation levels in children. The authors identified a set of CpGs that are associated with season of conception and show that these associations are likely driven by periconceptional environmental influences. These findings open the door for future studies of environmentally sensitive CpGs to link early life exposures to diseases occurring later in life.
